difficulty_reason: For a finitely presented morphism of affine schemes all of whose fibres have dimension d, the lemma produces a Noetherian approximation in which the approximating morphism again has all fibres of dimension d. The proof obtains the diagram from the general approximation lemma and descends the constant-dimension condition, using that it is expressible by finitely many equations in a finitely presented algebra. Descending the dimension condition is the load-bearing step. Retained author proof at lines 9959-9983.
